UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always include data-testid on interactive and key informative elements for automated testing.
Do not use transparent backgrounds without blur or backdrop filter.
Ensure contrast meets APCA standard and 4.5:1 ratio for normal text.
Maintain forest-green and warm paper organic palette.
Ensure image components use native responsive styles with max-h-[80vh] limits on mobile.
Never add fake customer logos or unverified testimonials.
